subject: prd/worker-transcript-metrics
statement: The system shall record, for each tool use within a recorded process, its kind identifier, its duration, and the token usage attributed to it.
rationale: J2 needs an attributable operation, not an unattributed spike *(#D-2, #D-9)*
fit_criterion: for a run on a harness exposing tool events, every tool use in the transcript appears in the record with those three figures present or declared unavailable
